## 3. Key Wave 2 Findings

1. **`colors_sed` 32-gather stencil & Simpson weights**: At 4096 zones, 4-thread Safe Rust evaluates `colors_sed` in `6770.62 us` vs. `106190.19 us` in MESA (`15.68x`). At 1024 zones, `@jax.jit(jax.vmap)` reaches `689.47 us` per profile vs. `25299.86 us` in MESA (`36.69x`).
2. **`ion_fe56` comparison**: At 4096 zones and 4 threads, MESA `eval_charge_of_Fe56_in_He4` (`32.05 us`) is faster than Safe Rust Stage 3 (`71.69 us`) and PyO3 Stage 1 (`46.74 us`).
